scope.task: Independent v2 review of AWS CardDemo reference draft: close FAIL-01..06 against source and assess MBT usability.

validator_results.direct_validator: PASS: 3 capabilities, 32 states, 62 transitions, 25 obligations, 6 resolved findings

effective_exposure.exposure_exception: One initial broad P3 file listing exposed names of non-allowed sibling artifacts and tool-supplied WORKSPACE-NOTES.md context. I did not read or use their contents for findings; this is recorded rather than hidden.

finding_closure.basis: CBTRN03C lines 170-178, 197-203, 248-265 support EOF totals only after the prior textual date test; v2 records unknown EOF receiver instead of universal totals. Remaining MBT issue: unknown branch is not a deterministic selectable path without external authority.
CBTRN03C lines 181-184 and 306-316 call account totals only on card change; EOF lines 197-203 call page/grand totals only. v2 adds TRANREPT-OBL-008.
CBTRN03C lines 170-178 NEXT SENTENCE skips to the next sentence after the loop sentence, bypassing lookup/detail/accrual lines 179-203; detail accrual lines 287-289 are not reached.

CBTRN02C lines 424-442 call TCATBAL then ACCOUNT then TRANFILE; lines 562-578 abend on WRITE TRANFILE status not 00. v2 models write failure after prior attempted effects and does not assert commit/rollback.
CBTRN02C lines 545-559 set reason 109 on ACCOUNT rewrite INVALID KEY without local abend; control returns to line 442 WRITE TRANFILE. v2 has separate continuation path.

The JSON is structurally richer, but guards/effects/observables are not executable semantics sufficient for deterministic MBT selection. The mechanical validator accepts source-contradicting effect/observable mutants.

blocking_findings.root_cause: The model changed representation from prose to JSON but did not define an executable transition semantics.
evidence: effects and observables remain arbitrary strings
no state update language for counters, accumulated totals, current card/account, first flags, receiver contents, or writes
no typed valuation schema for concrete input generation
blocking_findings.impact: A path selector cannot deterministically compute next states, expected outputs, or test data from the model alone.

blocking_findings.root_cause: Guard AST is syntactically checked, not semantically complete.
evidence: operators list includes gte/lte/exists/changed/first_record but only shallow validation is implemented
eq/ne/gte/lte do not check literal type/domain
unknown guard has policy text but no formal interaction with other guards
blocking_findings.impact: Reachability over a finite graph is not equivalent to decidable, disjoint, satisfiable path selection.

blocking_findings.root_cause: Loop bounds are labels, not traversal semantics.
evidence: parameters maxDailyRecords/maxTcatbalRecords/maxTranRecords/maxCards exist but transitions do not decrement/increment bounded counters in machine-readable form
loops P_OPENED, I_OPENED, R_LOOP can be traversed indefinitely unless an external harness imposes limits
blocking_findings.impact: The artifact proves finite graph topology, not finitability of generated executions or loop coverage criteria.

blocking_findings.root_cause: Mechanical PASS is insensitive to semantic mutants.

mutations.mutation: invert no-final-update-at-EOF into final ACCOUNT update

blocking_findings.impact: The current three positive tests and validator cannot demonstrate rejection of invalid MBT models.

blocking_findings.root_cause: Obligation coverage is by refID presence, not source obligation satisfaction.
evidence: transitions may point to obligationRefs while their effects/observables contradict those obligations and still validate
source anchors prove file/line existence and hash, not that the transition statement correctly interprets the lines
blocking_findings.impact: resolution_matrix.decision and reference IDs cannot be used as independent proof of closure.

static_trace_samples.source: CBTRN03C lines 170-178 then sentence period at 206; report write/accrual at 179-203 and 287-289
static_trace_samples.trace: After READ status 00, if TRAN-PROC-TS text is outside DATEPARM range, NEXT SENTENCE transfers past the current sentence, so no lookup, no detail, no account/page accrual for that record.

EOF is set by 1000-TRANFILE-GET-NEXT at 248-265, but the program tests TRAN-PROC-TS(1:10) before IF END-OF-FILE. If that textual test is false, totals are skipped; if true, page/grand totals occur, and account total is still not called.

Accepted transaction performs TCATBAL update, ACCOUNT update/rewrite handling, then WRITE TRANFILE. TRANFILE status not 00 abends after those attempts; ACCOUNT INVALID KEY only sets reason 109 and continues.
READ status 10 sets END-OF-FILE=Y during an iteration entered with END=N; the outer ELSE with 1050 is not reached on normal EOF, and the loop exits before a final account update.

approval_condition: Classify a later draft PASS only after FAIL-06 is resolved with executable/decidable model semantics: typed domains and valuations, guard satisfiability/disjointness checks, transition update/effect schemas (not strings), explicit loop bounding/traversal policy, source-sensitive negative/mutant tests, and conditional handling of unknown EOF without inventing receiver retention.
